about: The playthrough's Leader Bugsy, from Azalea's Pokemon Center: swaps put the Noctowl first -- its Air Slash for his Ledian, four times as strong against his Heracross -- the Geodude second, the Quilava third, kept for his Scizor, whom its Fire hits four times as hard, the Misdreavus and the Flaaffy. Into the gym, whose carts and switches the game sets again on entering (AzaleaGymInit), by the shortest way to him -- station 0 to the middle, station 7 to the top left, the switch there (4, 7), station 9 down to the middle left, the switch (2, 18), station 6 up to the top middle -- then Bugsy and his five at 20 to 22; a loss sends the player to the nurse, and again: walks the gym again and fights him again, each attempt a new battle, four times more at most. The Hive Badge, TM89 and FLAG_GOT_TM89_FROM_BUGSY; out again by the switch beside him (11, 8), station 10 and station 4, the nurse, and the game's save. The party is edited here, and says so: savedit --train 22 raises the bot's own team to the cap Proton's defeat set, evolving the Hoothoot into Noctowl and the Mareep into Flaaffy with the moves the game gives them there. The team the bot brings -- its Quilava at 22, Geodude 20, Misdreavus 17, Mareep 13 and Hoothoot 12 -- lost to him ten times in two orders, never past his Ledian, Shuckle or Scizor: his Ledian and Heracross want the Noctowl the Hoothoot becomes at 20, and the Hoothoot, the weakest of the team since it was caught, wins too little alone -- relieved in Ilex Forest, 2,700 frames a battle for about 130 points, some fifty battles from 10 to 20, and Ilex lies past the rival's battle at Azalea's west gate, his five at 22. Training it in play is what remains. On round 14's merged tree the team comes with the Quilava and the Geodude at 21, the Misdreavus 16, the Hoothoot and the Mareep 13, the edit raising all five, and Bugsy falls at the second attempt, as where the leg was written (39,674 frames as the joined chain plays it). The field's RNG is pinned and the battle's seed fixed.

lines: You are challenged by Leader Bugsy!
